blocks.title: Debuggers
blocks.text: Debuggers woh tools hain jo developers ko apne code mein ghaltiyan (bugs) dhoondne aur theek karne mein madad dete hain. Yeh developers ko code test karne aur ghalti ki jagah pehchanne dete hain.

items: GDB: C aur C++ ke liye GNU Debugger.
Visual Studio Debugger: Visual Studio IDE mein shamil.

blocks.prompt: Debugger bug dhoondne mein kaise madad deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh developer ko program qadam ba qadam chalane aur variables dekhne deta hai, to woh theek line mil jati hai jahan program ghalat hota hai.

items: Debuggers: code test kar ke aur ghalti ki jagah pakar kar bugs dhoondne aur theek karne ke tools; GDB, Visual Studio Debugger.
